note: Monday daily scrape. Genuinely slow discovery cycle — the week of July 6-10 was a light fintech-funding week ($350M across ~10 deals). The three fresh, in-ICP triggers this cycle are all funding-round pr-marketing leads; the strongest raises from the roundups (Taktile, Bespoke Labs, EquiLibre) were already deduped from the July 7-10 reports. Freelance-pipeline searches again surfaced evergreen marketplace/aggregator pages and firms already in recent reports (Ropes & Gray, Latitude, Fractional Jobs, The Work Crowd, Robert Half) rather than fresh dated postings — deep freelance discovery continues in the separate pr-freelance and legal-freelance scrapes. Two new leads (Kord, Infinia) carry a geographic caveat: both are non-US-headquartered, so a US PR agency's fit hinges on US-market ambitions. BIGGEST development this run is in signal refresh, not discovery: Norm AI (existing pr-marketing lead) closed a $120M Series C at a $1.2B unicorn valuation AND launched Norm Law with an ex-Sidley chairman — this is now the hottest lead in the CRM and the window is wide open.

Identify comms/marketing lead; if in-house comms is thin relative to the moment, this is also a fractional/overflow opening worth flagging to the pr-freelance track.
